title: Office visit with a knee injection

rules: All payers: an office visit on the same day as a minor procedure needs modifier 25 if the visit was a separate, significant service.
All payers: the diagnosis laterality (right or left) must match the procedure modifier (RT or LT).

sections.question: Line 1 is an office visit on the same day as the injection. What does line 1 need?
options: Nothing. It is correct as it is
sections.feedback: The note shows a separate evaluation of diabetes, so the visit needs modifier 25 to be paid alongside the injection.

sections.title: Diagnosis and side
sections.question: The injection has modifier LT. Does the diagnosis match the side?
options: Yes. M17.12 is the left knee
No. The diagnosis should be for the right knee
The side does not matter for injections
sections.feedback: M17.12 is left knee osteoarthritis and the procedure has LT, so the side matches the note.

sections.title: Your decision
sections.question: What should you do with this claim?
options: Fix the claim, then submit it
Hold it and get what is missing first
sections.feedback: Add modifier 25 to line 1, then submit.

rules: Medicare Part B: outpatient physical therapy services need modifier GP.

sections.question: This is outpatient physical therapy billed to Medicare. What modifier does line 1 need?
sections.feedback: Medicare needs modifier GP on outpatient physical therapy services.

sections.title: Units
sections.question: The note records 40 minutes of one timed service. How many units is that?
sections.feedback: Under the 8 minute rule, 38 to 52 minutes is 3 units. The claim has 2.

sections.title: Your decision
sections.question: What should you do with this claim?
options: Fix the claim, then submit it
Hold it and get what is missing first
sections.feedback: Add GP and change the units to 3, then submit.
